title: The Undercurrent: Three European Artists on Making Money Visible
summary: Bitcoin Magazine The Undercurrent: Three European Artists on Making Money Visible Ahead of Bitcoin Amsterdam, ZETRA, RYR, and Cypherpunk Now reflect on the cultural roots of bitcoin, the changing meaning of money, and a movement confronting its own institutional success. This post The Undercurrent: Three European Artists on Making Money Visible first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Dennis Koch .
